producer.boundary: Reconcile current writer, actual source/report identity and tests before a separate bounded source repair. This file grants no writer transfer.

consumer_question: What changed in outstanding option contracts, and which opening/closing interpretations remain mathematically possible?

observation_invariants.contract_key: unchanged economic series including expiry, right, strike, deliverable and corporate-action lineage
observation_invariants.volume_counting: matched unit-contract transactions counted once, not both participant sides
observation_invariants.population: OI and volume must cover the same market/venue, series and interval for the conservation model
observation_invariants.oi_state: explicit integer observation with effective session and report/revision/receipt identity; missing is not zero
observation_invariants.provenance: content equality is not effective-vintage equality
observation_invariants.consumer_availability: every source, transform and publication/consumer receipt must precede the intended use
observation_invariants.removals: unknown non-trading removal counts stay unknown or have independently justified bounds; positive adjustments require a different model

quantity_semantics.net_by_strike_change: abs(sum(latest_contract_oi - prior_contract_oi) grouped by strike/right) is a different view
quantity_semantics.bounds: conditional identified set, not a confidence interval or calibrated probability
quantity_semantics.oif09: requires qualified observed non-market-maker buyer-opening classifications; bounds cannot supply missing labels

required_cases.case: same root/count/spot/total but contract OI redistributes 50/150 to 150/50
required_cases.expect: content differs; +100 and -100 changes are not suppressed by aggregate equality

required_cases.case: equal contract OI contents with proven distinct effective sessions
required_cases.expect: measured net zero at those sessions is not labelled a reused report solely because content matches

required_cases.case: same effective OI report arrives with changed spot
expired contract absent from the next response
required_cases.expect: absence is not an observed zero or a closing-trade count

required_cases.case: two expiries on one strike have +100 and -100 OI changes
required_cases.expect: net-by-strike view may be zero; per-contract OIF18 numerator remains 200

required_cases.case: whole-market OI is paired with only one exchange's partial volume
required_cases.expect: do not admit the complete-market conservation bounds

required_cases.case: participant-side volume is supplied as matched volume
required_cases.expect: refuse or normalize only under exact product/exchange/schema/date convention; never a universal heuristic

required_cases.case: next-morning OI was not received at the prior-day prediction time
required_cases.expect: not an available prior-day feature even when the file's date matches

required_cases.case: zero trades, 100 initial OI, 0 final OI, 100 independently established removals
required_cases.expect: zero closing trades; removal context displayed separately

required_cases.case: 100 trades, initial/final OI10, all selected buyer-side prints
required_cases.expect: buyer-opening possibilities remain 0..100; opening_probability stays null

required_cases.case: known zero initial OI versus missing initial OI
required_cases.expect: only genuine zero permits the first-trade opening restriction; missing input is refused

required_cases.case: unmatched contract identity or revised deliverable between snapshots
required_cases.expect: preserve excluded coverage and action lineage; no phantom open/close attribution

implementation_sequence: Consume the pinned source-vintage witness without rerunning unchanged original research.
Resolve effective/report/receipt identity from the existing source owner; do not derive it from equal contents or fetch date.
Implement the minimal identity/comparison correction with the incumbent producer tests on an admitted isolated source branch.
Keep the legitimate net-by-strike display separate from per-contract OIF18; preserve units and excluded coverage.
Obtain independent exact-head review and required checks; production source-to-consumer proof remains separately owed.
non_goals: new source store or publication authority
changing held methods or production policies
